segment.source: Renders the marks of the payment methods and billing arrangements you accept as a quiet row of logos, with one line of small print for the conditions. Use it for: the foot of a pricing page, the area above a checkout button, a billing help page, an invoice-on-account note for public bodies. Prefer 'Guarantee Band' when the reassurance is a promise rather than a set of marks, and 'Pricing FAQ' when each method needs its own explanation.
